scope: Free lane on macOS: API-key auth against a local fake model on 127.0.0.1 (auth status, the init-only isolation probe, model discovery, full turns with Read, Bash and Write). Seeded from the A1 spike on 2.1.280 (tests/fixtures/cli/claude-code/2.1.280). The login token refresh of a real sign-in is only observed by the paid canary; a Linux host may add its own cache paths.

entries.reason: Startup and bookkeeping state: first start, migrations, the feature-flag cache, plugin usage counters. Only the top-level keys in claudeJsonKeys may be added or changed; any other key, or a removed one, fails.

The lock folder around ~/.claude.json writes. `claude auth status` (EYAS's sign-in check) exits without removing it; the next Claude Code run that writes ~/.claude.json clears it as stale, so a later run may remove it (live lane, 2.1.281).
Folder of Claude Code's ~/.claude.json backups.
Copy of the previous ~/.claude.json taken before Claude Code rewrites it; it may hold only keys the file already had or listed bookkeeping keys.
Running-session registry folder; it must be empty once the process exited.
Folder of per-session environment folders.
An empty per-session folder (A1 spike, full turn). A file inside it is content and fails.
Folder of login-shell snapshots taken for the Bash tool.
Snapshot of the login shell's functions, aliases and options; it must contain no conversation content (no canary, no sentinel).
An empty folder Claude Code 2.1.281 creates at start (live lane).
An empty folder Claude Code 2.1.281 creates when a tool runs (live lane).
An empty folder Claude Code 2.1.281 creates when a tool runs (live lane).
The XDG config folder, created when the host has none (the parent of the one below).
An empty folder Claude Code 2.1.281 creates at start (live lane).
npm's folder: Claude Code runs `npm root --global` at start (its install-location check).
npm's log folder (npm keeps the ten newest).
npm's own log of `npm root --global`: the command, npm and runtime versions, the working folder. No conversation content.
macOS user Library folder (the parent of the cache below).
macOS user cache folder.
Bun's transpiler cache, written when the `npm` Claude Code starts runs on Bun (a PATH whose `node` is Bun, as under `bun run`).
Bun's transpiler cache entries (compiled npm code). No conversation content.
Login token refresh on a host without a keychain. Never read, never content-checked.
